label: Govee Lights
tagline: Let viewers recolour your Govee lights with channel points.
description: Viewers redeem a channel-points reward, type a colour (a name like "blue" or a hex like #00ccff), and the bot turns your Govee light on and sets it. Live only: redemptions off-stream are refunded automatically. To get your Govee API key: open the Govee Home app, tap Profile (bottom right), tap the settings gear (top right), tap "Apply for API Key", fill in the short form, and Govee emails you a key within a few minutes. Then on this page: paste the key (we store it encrypted and never show it back), pick the light to control, and create the reward.
